title: Aphel setup
description: Set up the organization and the administrator account. This wizard appears only once.

hints.timezone: Used in dates, reminders and reports. Can be changed later.

errors.passwordLength: The password must be between 8 and 128 characters.
errors.statusFailed: Could not check whether Aphel is already installed.
errors.network: No connection to the server. Check your network and try again.
errors.generic: The installation could not be completed. Please try again.

email.title: Outgoing email
email.description: Set up the SMTP server used for invitations, password resets and notifications. You can skip this step and do it later.
email.later: Without outgoing email, invitations and password resets show a link for you to copy and hand over. You can change it in Settings → Outgoing email.

restore.title: Restore from a backup
restore.description: Use the backup file (.zip) exported from another Aphel installation. Restoring is only possible on this empty installation.
restore.hint: The backup brings the organization, users, records and files. Afterwards, sign in with an account from the backup.

errors.tooLarge: The file is larger than allowed.
errors.generic: Could not restore the backup. Try again.
